plate_findings.evidence: Alopecia over scalp, eyebrows, lower eyelid sparing upper eyelid
Involvement of trunk in the form of ichthyosis with erythema and brownish adherent scaling

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 5 panels (A, B, C, D, E). A: Infant with KID syndrome article; caption explicitly describes scalp and eyebrow alopecia, classic KID alopecia. B: Truncal ichthyotic erythrokeratoderma with adherent scaling matches KID stippled hyperkeratotic/ichthyotic plaques. C: Perianal hyperkeratotic plaque in KID infant; hyperkeratotic plaque corresponds to vocabulary stippled hyperkeratotic plaques. D: Caption explicitly states stippled keratoderma of sole, textbook palmoplantar keratoderma of KID syndrome. E: Bilateral groin erythematous macerated plaques in KID infant; maps to erythrokeratoderma/hyperkeratotic plaques vocabulary.

panels.figure_caption: A, Alopecia over scalp, eyebrows, lower eyelid sparing upper eyelid. B, Involvement of trunk in the form of ichthyosis with erythema and brownish adherent scaling. C, Hyperkeratotic brownish plaque surrounding anus. D, Stippled keratoderma of right sole. E, Symmetrical involvement of bilateral groins in the form of erythematous macerated plaque.
in_text_mentions: ling. The perianal region showed hyperkeratotic plaque with erythema. Bilateral groins revealed macerated, ill-defined erythematous plaques.
